title: GitHub
description: See what on GitHub needs you: pull requests waiting on your review, your own with their checks, issues given to you and CI runs that failed.
examples: Type pull: PRs waiting on your review first, then yours, each with its checks passing or failing; Return opens it on github.com
Type failing: CI runs that failed in your repos this week; Cmd+K re-runs only the failed jobs
